coverage_definitions.NOT_COMPLETED_WITHIN_BUDGET: One or more physical trials ran but no successful trial has been observed; this does not establish impossibility.
coverage_definitions.NOT_RUN/ERROR: No usable completed physical trial exists for the level.
coverage_definitions.PROVEN_REACHABLE_IN_BOUNDED_TRIAL: At least one telemetry-valid production-physics trial completed all normal To-Go objectives.
coverage_definitions.VERIFIED_DATA_INVALID: The canonical runtime database did not provide the expected candidate record or explicit validation failed.

interpretation: A successful bounded solver trial demonstrates reachability for that scenario, not human fairness. Failed seeds are not proofs of impossibility. No difficulty or player-quality acceptance is inferred.
